name: lungs
title: Lungs
about: Paired organs of gas exchange: the right lung has three lobes, the left has two, and each divides into segments.
credit: Lobes and airway: HRA 3D Reference Object Library, HuBMAP, from NLM Visible Human data (CC BY 4.0). Large and segmental vessels: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science, CC BY 4.0, adapted (registered to this airway). Vessels finer than the data, surface colour and texture: illustration.

groups.label: Right upper lobe
groups.about: Three segments at the top of the right lung, above the horizontal and oblique fissures.

groups.label: Right middle lobe
groups.about: Two segments, found only on the right, between the horizontal and oblique fissures.

groups.label: Right lower lobe
groups.about: Five segments at the base of the right lung, behind and below the oblique fissure.

groups.label: Left upper lobe
groups.about: The upper left lobe, including the lingula, which wraps around the heart's notch.

groups.label: Left lower lobe
groups.about: Five segments at the base of the left lung, behind and below the oblique fissure.

groups.label: Airway
groups.about: Air travels down the trachea and divides again and again through the bronchi.

groups.label: Pulmonary arteries
groups.about: Carry oxygen-poor blood from the heart into the lungs.

groups.label: Pulmonary veins
groups.about: Carry oxygen-rich blood from the lungs back to the heart.

parts.label: Larynx cartilages
parts.about: The thyroid, cricoid, epiglottic and arytenoid cartilages, which frame the voice box above the trachea.

parts.label: Tracheal rings
parts.about: C-shaped hoops of cartilage that hold the windpipe open. They are open at the back, against the oesophagus.

parts.label: Trachea wall
parts.about: The soft wall between the rings, with the flat membrane at the back that closes each C.

parts.label: Main bronchi
parts.about: The first division of the airway at the carina, one to each lung.

parts.label: Lobar bronchi
parts.about: One to each lobe: three on the right, two on the left.

parts.label: Segmental bronchi
parts.about: One to each segment, branching on toward the air sacs.

parts.label: Bronchial cartilage
parts.about: Rings in the main bronchi that break into irregular plates further in.

parts.label: Pulmonary trunk and arteries
parts.about: The trunk leaves the right ventricle and divides under the arch of the aorta, sending one large artery into each lung's hilum, carrying oxygen-poor blood.

parts.label: Right pulmonary arteries
parts.about: Carry oxygen-poor blood in, running beside the bronchi and dividing with them. Large and segmental branches are measured anatomy; the fine twigs are illustration. Coloured coral here for visibility.

parts.label: Left pulmonary arteries
parts.about: Carry oxygen-poor blood in, running beside the bronchi and dividing with them. Large and segmental branches are measured anatomy; the fine twigs are illustration. Coloured coral here for visibility.

parts.label: Right pulmonary veins
parts.about: Bring oxygen-rich blood back toward the heart, running between the segments rather than beside the bronchi. Large and segmental branches are measured anatomy; the fine twigs are illustration. Coloured wine here for visibility.

parts.label: Left pulmonary veins
parts.about: Bring oxygen-rich blood back toward the heart, running between the segments rather than beside the bronchi. Large and segmental branches are measured anatomy; the fine twigs are illustration. Coloured wine here for visibility.

layers.label: Lobes
layers.about: The five lobes and their twenty segments, closed in glass at rest so the vessels show.

layers.label: Vessels
layers.about: The pulmonary arteries and veins, from the great trunks to hair-fine twigs.

layers.label: Airway
layers.about: The larynx, the ringed trachea and the whole bronchial tree.

flows.label: Oxygen-poor blood, to the right lung
flows.about: Blood from the right ventricle reaches the lung through the pulmonary arteries, thinning out toward the air sacs.
